protocol.status: Post-test explanatory diagnosis; existing sealed benchmark stays unchanged
protocol.oracle_passive: All64 fresh TEST layouts and all12 secondary TEST episodes; supply exact simulator material, support/load locations and families, force vectors and support motion
protocol.oracle_controlled: z0000..z0007, all four candidate controls and the independent diagonal evaluation control; exact physical labels, original hardware, replace all unknown loads; compare both frozen forward checkpoints
protocol.reference_prior: Uniform counting measure on three material hypotheses; all nuisance parameters supplied exactly; validate matched geometry, camera, support, load and other material coefficients before using bank
protocol.reference_sensor: 12 rest-interior native depth pixels at each public timestamp, excluding rest frame; prefix<=1s and all10 input snapshots reported separately
protocol.noise_covariance: sigma^2*(I + same-frame indicator + all-ones); independent, per-frame shared and sequence-shared components; no fitting to TEST
reference_comparisons: Same three physical hypotheses evaluated by passive neural forward operator and ray casting
Normalized amortized25D log-density slice at same three hypotheses
qualifications: Three-point simulator reference is a controlled conditional problem, not the full25D posterior
Noiseless depth-bank self-match is an upper bound; additional synthetic sensor replicates test calibration only under the declared likelihood
Flow-density slice conditions on true nuisance values, uses equal log-coordinate cell widths, and retains its learned prior; it is not a full marginal or an equal-prior Bayes posterior
The supplied-noise sensitivity is a declared diagnostic, not fitted physical sensor calibration
These reused TEST results are exploratory diagnosis, never a replacement for an untouched future test
No architecture, checkpoint or policy is selected or changed
